high_level_description: This image is an advertisement for the "Impulse - Brain Training" app, as indicated by the logo and text at the top left corner. The ad is sponsored, as noted by the label below the logo. The central theme of the image is to explore different types of intelligence and their prevalence among people. The title, "How Rare Is Your Type of Smart?", is prominently displayed at the top in bold, black letters. The image features a colorful map-like graphic with various sections, each representing a different type of intelligence: Logic Smart: Described as being good at solving problems and using math.
